summary: Completed full backend+frontend testing of HR Workflow Designer. 14/14 pytest backend tests pass (automations, validate, simulate, workflows CRUD with Mongo persistence, 404 handling, no _id leak). Frontend loads cleanly with all data-testids present; drag-drop via HTML5 DataTransfer works; duplicate Start shows toast; right-panel title editing updates node in real-time; theme toggle toggles .dark class; undo/redo works; auto-layout works; save workflow persists to Mongo and appears in Library dialog; empty-canvas simulate shows 'Cannot simulate: Workflow is empty' toast; simulation drawer opens with run/close buttons; all navbar data-testids render.

issues: CRA react-error-overlay surfaces benign 'ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications' as an Uncaught runtime error fullscreen overlay, blocking further UI interactions. This is cosmetic in production but disruptive during automation/testing. Suggest: add a window.addEventListener('error', e => { if (/ResizeObserver loop/.test(e.message)) e.stopImmediatePropagation(); }); in src/index.js to swallow it.

action_items: Optional: silence the ResizeObserver-loop error in dev (it is benign but triggers CRA's full-screen red overlay). Add an error listener in src/index.js as noted above.
critical_code_review_comments: server.js: Workflow schema correctly strips _id/__v via toJSON and lean projections. Good.
server.js: /api/simulate returns 400 with errors on invalid graphs — matches spec.
server.js: validateGraph correctly detects multiple Starts, missing Start/End, orphans, and cycles.
workflowStore.js pushHistory is called before add/remove/position-stop changes — undo/redo verified on clean run.
Frontend axios uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var — no hardcoded URLs.
No Mongo ObjectId leakage observed in any CRUD response.
Sidebar drag uses custom MIME 'application/hr-node-type'; tests must dispatch DragEvent with a DataTransfer carrying that key — documented in agent_to_agent_context_note.
seed_data_creation: Created + deleted TEST_ prefixed workflows during CRUD tests; one workflow 'TEST_UI_Workflow' was saved during UI testing and remains in DB (safe to ignore or clean).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env (currently https://hrflow-designer.preview.emergentagent.com). Backend is Express node server on :8001 managed by supervisor. For drag-drop in Playwright, dispatch native DragEvent with DataTransfer carrying key 'application/hr-node-type' and value in {start,task,approval,automated,end} to the canvas element at bounding-box-relative coordinates; see /app/backend/tests/test_hr_workflow_api.py style for backend regression. Connecting two nodes via UI requires mouse.down on source handle (.react-flow__handle.source) and mouse.up on target handle (.react-flow__handle.target) — in headless mode handles may not register; prefer asserting connect via backend API. The React-Flow dev-mode ResizeObserver warning can surface a blocking red overlay during automation; if encountered, reload or suppress via index.js.
